hints: The first element of preorder is always the root of the current subtree.
Everything left of the root in inorder is the left subtree, so its size k tells you how many of the following preorder elements belong to the left.
Recurse on sub-arrays with pointer arithmetic: left is (pre + 1, in, k), right is (pre + 1 + k, in + k + 1, n - k - 1).
source: PD Lab 10 Q5 options (e)/(f), integer version
title: Rebuild a tree from preorder + inorder
